columns.GENERATION_EXPRESSION: case when `submissionMode` = 'RELAYED' or `serviceWalletAddress` is not null then 'Automated (bot)' else 'Manual' end

GENERATION_EXPRESSION.liveCopy: case when `status` = _utf8mb4'submitted' and `walletAddress` is not null and trim(`walletAddress`) <> _utf8mb4'' then lcase(trim(`walletAddress`)) else NULL end
GENERATION_EXPRESSION.latest: case when `status` = 'submitted' and `walletAddress` is not null and trim(`walletAddress`) <> '' then lcase(trim(`walletAddress`)) else NULL end

GENERATION_EXPRESSION.liveCopy: case when `walletAddress` is not null and trim(`walletAddress`) <> _utf8mb4'' and `isDeleted` = 0 then lcase(trim(`walletAddress`)) else NULL end
GENERATION_EXPRESSION.latest: case when `walletAddress` is not null and trim(`walletAddress`) <> '' and `isDeleted` = 0 then lcase(trim(`walletAddress`)) else NULL end

GENERATION_EXPRESSION.liveCopy: case when `status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING_PAYMENT',_utf8mb4'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'MINT_SUBMITTED') then `interestUid` else NULL end
GENERATION_EXPRESSION.latest: case when `status` in ('PENDING_PAYMENT','PAYMENT_CONFIRMED','MINT_SUBMITTED') then `interestUid` else NULL end

GENERATION_EXPRESSION.liveCopy: case when `status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING_PAYMENT',_utf8mb4'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'MINT_SUBMITTED') then `investorUid` else NULL end
GENERATION_EXPRESSION.latest: case when `status` in ('PENDING_PAYMENT','PAYMENT_CONFIRMED','MINT_SUBMITTED') then `investorUid` else NULL end

GENERATION_EXPRESSION.liveCopy: case when `status` not in (_utf8mb4'COMPLETED',_utf8mb4'ISSUER_REJECTED',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED',_utf8mb4'EXPIRED') then `interestUid` else NULL end
GENERATION_EXPRESSION.latest: case when `status` not in ('COMPLETED','ISSUER_REJECTED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED') then `interestUid` else NULL end

GENERATION_EXPRESSION.liveCopy: case when `status` = _utf8mb4'PENDING_TRANSFER' then concat(lcase(`senderWalletAddress`),_utf8mb4':',lcase(`tokenAddress`)) else NULL end
GENERATION_EXPRESSION.latest: case when `status` = 'PENDING_TRANSFER' then concat(lcase(`senderWalletAddress`),':',lcase(`tokenAddress`)) else NULL end
